sheet_from: Data/World75/Tile*.OZJ, from MuMain, decoded under a cs_ prefix. World 74's own set and not Lorencia's - the slot table is shared, the art behind it is not, and TileRock02 here is coursed grey block where Lorencia's is a boulder face. The prefix is load-bearing: assets/textures is one flat pool for every world, Lorencia already owns tilegrass01.png through tilerock02.png, and without it nine of these twelve would have been silently answered by the town's sheets.
material_note: Read off the art, which here disagrees with the names more than Lorencia's did. TileGrass02 is not grass at all - it is an ornate brown floor laid in diamonds, and takes flagstone. TileGround02 is a raw red rock face and takes rock where the other 'ground' slots are laid surfaces. TileGround03 is mossed grass over stone, the same picture as TileGrass01, and takes grass with it. TileWood01 is not planking either: it is sandy stone in courses. Of the five rocks only TileRock04 is small enough in the course to read as cobble; the rest are cut block, which is flagstone.
tile_note: Twelve slots because twelve are in the map, but the map is not evenly spread and nothing about that is a mistake. World 74 is a set rather than a town: 99.5% of its 65,536 tiles are TileRock02 filler nobody ever sees, and the scene is the 158 walkable tiles at x 74-87, y 187-199 with the objects standing round them. What is actually drawn behind the five characters is TileRock02 under overlays of TileGround03 and TileGround01, which is grass and setts fading into cut block.
